statement_text: Our Q3 2023 revenue grew 12% year-over-year. Demand across all business segments remained strong and we see no signs of slowdown heading into Q4.
We have never participated in any coordinated pricing discussions with competitors. Every pricing decision this company makes is independent and fully compliant with antitrust law.
Our environmental compliance record is exemplary. We have recorded zero EPA violations and zero reportable environmental incidents across all manufacturing sites in the past five years.
There are no known material defects in our NovaDrive X1 product line. Customer satisfaction scores remain above 95% and we have received no credible safety complaints.
Our IT infrastructure experienced no security incidents in 2023. Customer data remains fully protected and no unauthorized access to our systems has occurred.
